summary: R9 matrix is internally sound, but the Opus carrier shipped bare ancestry instead of the required verification capsule. The subject set therefore did not reproduce Git, prior-lane, or three-repeat attestations; ancestry age was also off by 0.001 seconds.

findings.statement: The single lane attachment is bare continuation ancestry, not the doctrine-required closed-key verification capsule.
VerificationCapsulePath has no matching subject, so the control suite cannot reproduce from the packet.
Six prior receipt files are still hashed outside the subject set.
No subject carries readable R9 PASS output, repeat count, assertion count, or executable identity.
No subject carries readable commit/tree/type/branch/clean-status attestation.
Published capacity_age_seconds 170.893 differs from derived 170.892 and fails the exactness assertion.
The carrier replacement is only a boolean and does not bind old/new hashes or a close-before-clear receipt.
The shipped ancestry contains no signer, signature, or signed-observation binding.
The ancestry does not bind packet, route, session, model, or core digest.
The carrier omits normalized core_subjects_sha256 evidence.
The 29,162-byte core leaves 3,606 bytes for the required capsule under the 32 KiB limit.

next_action: Forward-only R10 must ship one closed-key compact capsule containing current route-bound ancestry, Git objects, three-repeat local control, validated prior-lane extracts, signed-capacity binding, and exact carrier replacement hashes; restart at Fable.
